title: Reporter Tools
intro: Choose a tool to open its demo, tutorial, or direct setup link. ChatGPT and AI Drive tools are grouped separately.

quickLinks.title: Customizer
quickLinks.description: Set your preferences before using the AI Drive Sidekicks.
quickLinks.label: Open Customizer

items.title: Dictionary Builder Sidekick
bullets: By understanding what the word list is for, the Sidekick creates focused lists that save you time.
Keep using the same conversation while editing. Because it has the context from creating your word list, it can help you figure things out faster.
items.description: Provide a name, subject, or pasted text and get a high-quality, dictionary-ready word list—no editing needed.

items.title: Transcript Sidekick
bullets: Unlike regular AI, it looks for the phonetic match instead of suggesting the “appropriate” word.
It explains the reason for each suggestion, so you can move on without replaying the audio or exhausting Google searches.
Help with technical terms, words you didn't understand, or anything else you're stuck on.
Help with those impossible-to-punctuate answers.
Give it a sentence and it uses the context to help—then asks for more if needed.
items.description: End the endless Google searches. Get phonetic help that uses context and explains every suggestion.

items.title: Appearance Pages Sidekick
bullets: Attorney information is searched and verified.
Results are custom formatted for appearance pages, CATalyst Fill-in Fields, or Eclipse Form Fields.
You get links to attorney bio pages and other sources, so you can quickly verify the information yourself.
No editing copied text or typing it in by hand.
items.description: Provide an attorney and firm name—up to three at a time—and get custom-formatted information ready for appearance pages or CAT software.

items.title: Practice Dictation Sidekick
bullets: Choose Q&A, literary, jury charge, or a plain list of items.
Dictation uses ChatGPT's Read Aloud feature, optimized for practicing at faster speeds.
A future update will add testing and grading simulations at various speeds.
items.description: Custom practice dictation for subject matter, case-prep word lists, trouble words, briefs, numbers, or dates—with optional analysis.
